## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or discussion.

## Validation

Describe the tests or reproduction performed, the result, and anything not checked.
For rendering changes, include the scene/settings and a same-session native/fallback comparison when applicable.

## Source and publication

Identify any new third-party source and its license, or state that none was added.
Keep game files, generated game C++, shaders/caches, binaries and private logs out of the contribution.
Run the publication check and inspect the staged diff as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
